Get W League Play-by-Play

Source: R/wjbl.R
wjbl_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a final game (2018-19 on): one row per play, Japanese action vocabulary, no shot x/y.

Endpoint: GET https://api.wjbl.01core.app/api/pbp/play-by-play

Usage

wjbl_pbp(play_schedule_id)

Arguments

play_schedule_id

Game id (play_schedule_id in wjbl_schedule): ONE global sequence across every league edition and season, e.g. 7987 (2025-26 playoff final game 1), 5533 (2018-19), 4243 (2013-14 final, box score only). The game must be final.

Value

A wehoop_data tibble, one row per record; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py wjbl_pbp):

col_nametypedescription
play_schedule_idintegerGame id play_schedule_id (key space: W League games, ONE global sequence across every league_id and season, e.g. 4243 = 2013-14 final, 7987 = 2025-26 final). The play_schedule_id parameter of every game route and of the site's /schedule_result/detail/*?play_schedule_id= pages.
nointegerPlay sequence number, ascending, 1 = first; numbers can skip (deleted plays: 443 numbers for 439 rows on 7987).
periodintegerPeriod: 1-4 = quarters, 5-14 = overtime 1-10 (the site's tab map). Integer.
rest_timecharacterGame clock REMAINING in the period, 'm:ss' without a leading zero ('9:38'; '10:00' at the start, 5:00 in overtime).
seconds_remainingintegerSeconds remaining in the period, from the 'm:ss' clock string rest_time.
team_idintegerActing team: franchise id team_id; null on period and game-end lines.
team_namecharacterActing team name, Japanese (may contain a full-width space and differ from the box score's spelling); empty on period/game-end lines.
team_sidecharacterSide of the acting team, home or away (from home_away: 1 home, 2 away); null on period and game-end lines.
player_number1characterShirt number of the first actor (the player going OUT on a substitution), a string; ” on team and period lines.
player_number2characterShirt number of the second actor (the player coming IN on a substitution), a string; ” otherwise.
player_name1characterName of the first actor, Japanese; ” on team and period lines.
player_name2characterName of the second actor (substitution in), Japanese; ” otherwise.
player_id1integerFirst actor (the player going OUT on a substitution): Player id (key space: W League persons, STABLE across seasons and teams). Joins /boxscore home/away.players[].player_id and the player_id of /player (the pi= of the site's /player/detail?pi=). Null on team and period lines.
player_id2integerSecond actor, filled on substitutions only (the player coming IN; verified 89/89 on game 7987): Player id (key space: W League persons, STABLE across seasons and teams). Joins /boxscore home/away.players[].player_id and the player_id of /player (the pi= of the site's /player/detail?pi=). Null otherwise.
play_textcharacterDisplay text in Japanese: (Japanese text). Bracketed running counts: shots the player's points so far, assists/steals/blocks/turnovers count so far, rebounds '(o-d-t)' = the player's offensive-defensive-total so far, fouls '(a-b:c)' = a the player's personal fouls, b the team's fouls in the period, c free throws awarded (verified on 7987), substitution A out, B in. Empty on period and game-end lines.
scorecharacterScore 'HOME-AWAY' after the play ('4-3'); filled on scoring plays and period/game-end lines, ” otherwise.
home_scoreintegerHome points after the play, parsed from score ('HOME-AWAY'); null on plays that carry no score.
away_scoreintegerAway points after the play, parsed from score ('HOME-AWAY'); null on plays that carry no score.
end_period_flgintegerEnd-of-period flag (integer); 0 on every observed row, the period end is the (Japanese text) action instead.
end_game_flgintegerEnd-of-game flag: 1 on the final (Japanese text) line only (the site skips that row), else 0.
action1characterAction in Japanese (vocabulary of 8 full games, 2018-19 to 2025-26): player in (the starting five at the start of the game), substitution (player_id1 OUT, player_id2 IN), (Japanese text) / 'x' = two-point shot outside the paint made / missed ((Japanese text) inside-the-paint is not in the sample games), (Japanese text) / 'x' = three-point shot made / missed, (Japanese text) / 'x' = free throw made / missed, assist, offensive rebound, defensive rebound, (Japanese text) / team offensive / defensive rebound, steal, blocked shot, turnover, team turnover, personal foul, offensive foul, unsportsmanlike foul, timeout, end of period (quarter or overtime), end of game. o = made, x = missed.
action2characterSub-action in Japanese: jump shot (on field-goal attempts), free throws awarded on this foul, N = 0-3; ” otherwise.
action3characterSecond qualifier in Japanese: shooting foul; ” otherwise.
home_awayintegerSide of the acting team: 1 = home, 2 = away; null on period/game-end lines.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the JSON backend of www.wjbl.org (api.wjbl.01core.app), keyless, found in the site's own JavaScript. The site's terms of use (www.wjbl.org/kiyaku/) forbid reproducing, republishing or otherwise using site content without permission: a copyright clause, not an anti-scraping one. The wrappers fetch on the user's behalf; a published data release or a hosted mirror needs the owner's decision first. The site has no robots.txt (404, checked 2026-10-12), so no Crawl-delay is published; the runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Women's league: the W League is Japan's top women's basketball league (the SportsDataverse R counterpart is wehoop). All text is Japanese (team names, phases, play-by-play actions); the column descriptions translate the vocabulary.

  • Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26, 2000 = 1999-2000). The API keys a season edition by an opaque league_id (45 = '25-26 W League'; every all-star game, cup and camp has one too) and the wrappers map the END year with the live league list (one extra, cached request; END = 2000 + the second YY of league_title). Phases inside an edition (season_id: 169 = regular season Premier, 170 = Future, 176 = playoff final; two divisions from 2024-25) are native ids, passed as given: wjbl_standing_seasons lists them with their END year.

  • The schedule is paged by month: wjbl_schedule answers ONE month (game_month, YYYY-MM; omitted = the season's latest month only). List the months with wjbl_game_months and loop. The game routes take only the global play_schedule_id and serve final games only: each makes one extra, cached request (the game header) to prove the game is final and that the answer is the game and the teams asked for.

  • Errors are HTTP 200: an unknown id answers [] (wehoop_no_data) and a missing or non-numeric parameter answers an error envelope (wehoop_asset_fetch). Coverage: schedules from 1999-2000, box scores from 2013-14, play-by-play and the period stats from 2018-19 (earlier games answer [] on the /pbp routes: wehoop_no_data). No route carries shot coordinates.

  • Personal data: the organiser's contact details (phones, e-mail) and the player's blood type are never output, and phone numbers and e-mail addresses inside free text are replaced by [redacted-phone] / [redacted-email]. Do not add them back. Player bio fields and referee names are public and stay.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting wehoop_error: wehoop_no_data (HTTP 404 or the API has nothing for the request: an empty list, an id it does not know, a game without play-by-play before 2018-19, a season without months or games), wehoop_bad_request (a season that is not the END year of a W League edition, an id that is not an integer or a game_month that is not YYYY-MM, raised before the request, or the API's HTTP 400 / 422) and wehoop_asset_fetch (any other failure: an error envelope at HTTP 200, any other non-2xx, an empty or non-JSON body, a game that is not final, a truncated play-by-play, or a body for another game, league edition, month, team, season phase or player than the one asked for; transient is TRUE for 408 / 429 / 5xx and transport failures). HTTP 500 is retried. Wrappers raise; they never warn and return an empty frame.

See also

Other WJBL Functions: wjbl_box_score(), wjbl_game(), wjbl_game_info(), wjbl_game_months(), wjbl_head_to_head(), wjbl_leagues(), wjbl_period_scores(), wjbl_player(), wjbl_player_period_leaders(), wjbl_roster(), wjbl_schedule(), wjbl_staff(), wjbl_standing_seasons(), wjbl_team_box_score(), wjbl_team_period_stats(), wjbl_team_ranking(), wjbl_team_standings(), wjbl_teams()
